mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for an electrical business?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for seeing AEO results can vary, typically ranging from a few weeks to several months. Initial improvements in visibility for specific questions might appear quicker, especially with a well-optimized Google Business Profile. More significant gains in broader search queries and featured snippets usually require consistent effort in content creation, technical optimization, and monitoring. AEO is an ongoing strategy, not a one-time fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results from AEO can appear in weeks to months, depending on consistent optimization efforts and specific goals.
